task.description: Produce/refresh ADP-04b test specification and test-design evidence for implemented behavior: default-tenant backfill to bpm-default, OIDC-enabled tenant creation validation requiring idp_realm_id for non-default tenants, compatibility for existing/default tenant flows, and realm ownership invariants aligned with ADP-04a/OIDC-12. Ensure traceability from requirement acceptance criteria to concrete tests already in integration suite and identify any missing test cases as explicit issues if present.
acceptance_criteria: ADP-04b test spec exists and maps each requirement acceptance criterion to concrete test cases
Spec documents deterministic assertions for default-tenant backfill and tenant-creation validation boundaries
Cross-reference to ADP-04a realm ownership invariants is explicit where relevant
If gaps exist, issues list includes severity and exact missing coverage

result.summary: Produced ADP-04b test specification with deterministic acceptance-criteria traceability to concrete integration tests and explicit ADP-04a/OIDC-12 invariant cross-references.

issues.description: Missing explicit integration test for OIDC-enabled default-tenant validation boundary that must reject non-'bpm-default' realm values with IdentityError.DefaultTenantRealmMismatch.
Missing explicit integration test proving OIDC-enabled default-tenant create/bootstrap normalizes omitted realm binding to 'bpm-default'.
